title: Freya and the Archive
author: Wren Yarrow
blurb: Xanthe Pemberton, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the fleet's truce expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
